meaning:
βραβεῖον, -ου, τό
(βραβεύς, an umpire),
a prize in the games: 1Co.9:24; metaphorically, of the Christian's reward, Php.3:14.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, that you may win.
I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
